nina: quick heads-up — automated least-priv scan found several principals with admin role but no owner. posting minimal extract and a suggested low-risk cleanup flow.

nina: ```
PRINCIPAL               ROLE    LAST_ACTIVE
svc-feature-flagger      admin   2025-10-20
svc-ci-deployer          admin   2024-12-11
svc-compat-migrator      admin   2023-07-02
user:release-bot         admin   2025-01-08
svc-experiments-proxy    admin   2025-06-15
```

nina: command: `rbac-check --role admin --ownerless --since 2023-01-01 --limit 100`

omar: thanks. can we get KMS grant correlation for svc-feature-flagger and svc-ci-deployer before outreach? if they hold decrypt rights we need to add key-rotation to the plan.

sec-tooling: attached minimal audit snippet for svc-feature-flagger:

sec-tooling: ```
2025-10-20T03:14Z auth.token_issued principal=svc-feature-flagger
2025-09-15T21:44Z iam.grant KMS:decrypt principal=svc-feature-flagger key=projects/redwood/kms/keys/flags-key
```

lee: that flags-key grant means medium risk. proposed flow: 1) owner outreach 4 business days; 2) staging tag + 48h smoke; 3) prod canary disable admin role for 24h while preserving KMS grants; 4) if safe, rotate keys and remove admin role; 5) post-prune audit 7d.

nina: +1. I'll open ticket SEC-7210 "recert: orphan-admins cleanup" and attach exports. assigning outreach to @omar and @lee.

ops-bot: NOTE: auto-tagging principals found in automated scan with `recert:pending` and scheduling follow-up in 3d.

omar: small add: before any key rotation, run `key-usage --key flags-key --since 2025-01-01` to estimate traffic and avoid re-encrypt storms. @infra please run and paste results in SEC-7210.

lee: also, include an emergency restore runbook step: create ephemeral admin token with TTL=1h and log a regrant event in the ticket so we can quickly recover if the canary impacts production.

nina: outreach draft in SEC-7210: "We detected that `svc-feature-flagger` has admin role but no owner on record. Please reply in 4 business days if this should remain; otherwise we'll follow staged disable + rotate runbook."

omar: good. if partner/external bindings show up in the KMS dump, we'll coordinate a joint window.
